verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਚੀਟੀ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਕੈ ਬਿਰਖ ਚੜੈ ਪੰਛੀ ਉਡ ਜਾਇ ਬੈਸੇ ਨਿਕਟ ਹੀ ਫਲ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise cheeTee kram kram kai birakh chaRai pa(n)chhee udd jai baise nikaT hee fal kai ||

en.bdb: Just as an ant crawls up the tree very slowly to reach the fruit, whereas a bird flies and reaches it instantly.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਗਾਡੀ ਚਲੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਲੀਕਨ ਮਹਿ ਧੀਰਜ ਸੈ ਘੋਰੋ ਦੌਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਬਾਂਇ ਦਾਹਨੇ ਸਬਲ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise gaaddee chalee jaat leekan meh dheeraj sai ghoro dhauar jai baa(n)i dhaahane sabal kai ||

en.bdb: Just as a bullock cart moving in the ruts of the path reaches its destination slowly but a horse moving on either side of the path moves fast and reaches the destination quickly.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਕੋਸ ਭਰਿ ਚਲਿ ਸਕੀਐ ਨ ਪਾਇਨ ਕੈ ਆਤਮਾ ਚਤੁਰ ਕੁੰਟ ਧਾਇ ਆਵੈ ਪਲ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise kos bhar chal sakeeaai na pain kai aatamaa chatur ku(n)T dhai aavai pal kai ||

en.bdb: Just as one does not cover even a mile in a few seconds but the mind reaches and wanders around in four directions in a split second.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਲੋਗ ਬੇਦ ਭੇਦ ਗਿਆਨ ਉਨਮਾਨ ਪਛ ਗੰਮ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਅਸਥਲ ਕੈ ॥੪੦੪॥
verses.translit_en: taise log bedh bhedh giaan unamaan pachh ga(n)m gur charan saran asathal kai ||404||

en.bdb: Similarly, the knowledge of Vedas and worldly affairs is based on arguments and exchange of views. This method is like the movement of an ant. But by taking the refuge of the True Guru, one reaches the infallible and stable places of the Lord in no time.  (404)
